label: Whatever has the nine SIMPLE_4, PERFECT_2, INFINITE_1 attributes is INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2
paraphrase: Whatever is simple, universally perfect, supremely good, such that whatever is GOD_4 is it (uniqueness only), infinite, altogether immutable, eternal, and has intellect and will is INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2: it is INFINITE_1, and no intellect whose being some other being causes comprehends it (the primitive relation Comprehends). Derived from the infinity of the nine (nineAreIncomprehensibleToCausedIntellects; no other of the nine is used) with the two open bridges 'Whatever has its being caused by another is not INFINITE_1' and 'No intellect that is not INFINITE_1 comprehends an INFINITE_1 being'. INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 is not INCOMPREHENSIBLE_1: the identification of Comprehends with knowing as perfectly as knowable, and creation from nothing, are not typed. It is not unknowability, by the form of its definition: only Comprehends is negated, and no knowing relation is typed.
